Workflow.Name: AdoptaDeliverCommunication
Workflow.Description: Adopta Communications: resolves the audience groups of a due scheduled communication and posts the Adopta card in Teams to each member, logging every delivery. New runs require Sending enabled = Yes in the active Adopta Setting.
